question_text: Maria was born in 1990 in the Philippines to a Filipino mother and a Japanese father who was not a diplomat. Under Article IV of the 1987 Constitution, what is Maria's citizenship status?

options.text: She is a Japanese citizen because her father is Japanese.

She is stateless because her parents have different nationalities.
